MYCN amplification worsens neuroblastoma; infant 4S may regress
Back to sleep positioning dramatically reduced SIDS
reference.pathophysiology: Developmental gene programmes gone awry produce malformation sequences, while prematurity exposes immature lungs, gut, retina and brain to oxygen and perfusion injury. Embryonal tumours arise when developmental progenitors fail to mature, retaining blastemal growth under syndromic tumour suppressor loss.
additionalDifferentials: Neuroblastoma versus Wilms tumour imaging and secretion
